name: Garrett County Agriculture Fair
blurb: Eight days of livestock, 4-H judging, tractor pulls and food at the county fairgrounds. It is the county's biggest week and the fairgrounds are booked solid, so it also decides what parking around McHenry looks like.

rule.hint: Early August — the fair publishes dates a year at a time and states no recurring rule

admission.note: Admission is charged; the amount is not confirmed. The fair publishes an admission page but does not state a figure we can quote.

warnings: The fairgrounds are also the venue for the Autumn Glory Craft & Gift Sale in October. Check which event you are booking for.

sources.label: Garrett County Agriculture Fair: official site
sources.note: States "August 1st – August 8th 2026" and "69th Annual". Publishes no recurring rule, so future years are not computed.

outstanding: PRIORITY: get the admission price, and whether there is a separate parking charge.
Ask whether the fair follows any recurring pattern — first full week of August, or set fresh each year. It would let us publish future years instead of going quiet.
Confirm the fairgrounds street address and gate times.
Confirm whether dogs are permitted on the fairgrounds during the fair.

name: Autumn Glory Festival
venue: Downtown Oakland and venues across the county
blurb: Five days built around the leaf change, with the Grand Feature Parade through downtown Oakland on the Saturday. It is the busiest weekend of the autumn in Garrett County, and the one where finding a room needs planning.

rule.hint: Early to mid October — the festival publishes dates a year at a time and states no recurring rule

admission.note: No admission cost is stated for the festival itself; individual events within it may charge. Not confirmed.

website.label: Autumn Glory Festival: Garrett County Chamber of Commerce

warnings: The Grand Feature Parade closes streets in downtown Oakland. The county has published detour notices in past years.
Do not assume a fixed weekend. 2023 ran 11–15 October and 2026 runs 7–11 October, and neither tracks Columbus Day consistently.

sources.label: Autumn Glory Festival: Garrett County Chamber of Commerce
sources.note: States "October 7 - 11 2026" and "59th Annual". Publishes no recurring rule.

sources.label: Autumn Glory Craft & Gift Sale 2026
sources.note: Craft and gift sale 9–10 October 2026 at the Exhibit Hall, Garrett County Fairgrounds, McHenry.

outstanding: PRIORITY: ask the Chamber whether the festival follows a rule — a stated pattern would let us publish future years rather than going quiet after 2026.

admission.note: Not confirmed. The ad names no admission price, which for a street market usually means free to walk in — but usually is not a source.

warnings: The artisan market opens at 5pm, an hour before the music.

name: Mountain Maryland Dragon Boat Festival
blurb: Dragon boat racing on Broadford Lake, with craft and food vendors on the bank. Racing needs a team and pre-registration; watching costs five dollars a car, which is one of the few prices anybody in this county actually publishes.

rule.hint: Late August, announced a year at a time

admission.note: $5 per car to spectate. Racing is by team registration: $1,300 for a 20-person boat, $1,000 for a 10-person boat, both pre-registered.

website.label: Dove Center: Mountain Maryland Dragon Boat Festival

warnings: Spectator admission is charged per car, not per person.
You cannot turn up and race. A team and pre-registration are required.

name: Deep Creek Lake Art, Wine & Spirits Festival
blurb: Two days at the fairgrounds: a premium spirits tasting on the Friday evening and the main art and wine festival on the Saturday, with 200 wines, local artisans and live music. Proceeds go to HART for Animals.

rule.hint: Second weekend of September, announced a year at a time

admission.note: Ticketed, and the price is not stated in the ad. Every adult ticket carries a coupon for the Wine & Spirits store — $25 with a Friday ticket, $15 with a Saturday one — and a combined Friday-and-Saturday ticket is cheaper bought in advance.

warnings: Two different events on two days. The Friday premium tasting and the Saturday festival are ticketed separately.
The fairgrounds also host the Agriculture Fair and the Autumn Glory craft sale. Check which event you are buying for.

sources.label: The Lakefront Magazine, August 2026, page 33
